# Third-party notices

Portside Lite is MIT-licensed (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). It's built on open-source software, and
each component keeps its own license. This file lists everything the installed app contains and
the license each one is under. The full license and notice texts ship with every release, in
`THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt` next to the executable (and in the portable zip).

The MPL-2.0 components (`cssparser`, `cssparser-macros`, `dtoa-short`, `option-ext`, `selectors`)
are used unmodified. Their source code is available from the repositories linked below.

<!-- Generated by scripts/third-party-notices.py. Edit the script, not this file. -->

## Notable components

| Component | Used for | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Tauri](https://tauri.app) | Desktop shell, IPC, tray, dialogs, notifications | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |
| [React](https://react.dev) | User interface | MIT |
| [kube-rs](https://kube.rs) and [k8s-openapi](https://github.com/Arnavion/k8s-openapi) | Kubernetes API client and types | Apache-2.0 |
| [russh](https://github.com/Eugeny/russh) | SSH connections and tunnels | Apache-2.0 |
| [ring](https://github.com/briansmith/ring) and [rustls](https://github.com/rustls/rustls) | TLS and cryptography | Apache-2.0 AND ISC; Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT |
| [SQLite](https://sqlite.org) (via [rusqlite](https://github.com/rusqlite/rusqlite)) | Local storage and full-text log search | Public domain (SQLite); MIT (rusqlite) |
| [Tokio](https://tokio.rs) | Async runtime | MIT |
| [CodeMirror](https://codemirror.net) | YAML editor | MIT |
| [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) | Icons | ISC (parts derived from Feather, MIT) |
| [Zustand](https://github.com/pmndrs/zustand) | UI state | MIT |
| [TanStack Virtual](https://tanstack.com/virtual) | Long log lists | MIT |
| [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) | Styling (build time; the generated CSS ships) | MIT |
| [Rust standard library](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust) | Compiled into the executable | MIT OR Apache-2.0 |

## Not bundled, but used

- **Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.** The installer downloads and installs it if it's missing.
  It's Microsoft software under Microsoft's own license terms, and it isn't redistributed in this
  repository.
- **Inno Setup** builds the installer. Its [license](https://jrsoftware.org/files/is/license.txt)
  allows commercial use. Inno Setup isn't part of the installed app.
- **BusyBox** (`busybox` container image, GPL-2.0) is the default image for the volume file
  browser's helper pod. Your cluster pulls it from its registry. Portside Lite doesn't contain or
  distribute it, and the image can be changed in Settings.

## Acknowledgements

- The color palette is adapted from [Dracula](https://draculatheme.com) (MIT).
- Kubernetes is a registered trademark of The Linux Foundation. k3s is a CNCF project. Portside
  Lite isn't affiliated with or endorsed by either.
